snippet.title: Case Solved: The London Files | Console Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4127360/Case_Solved_The_London_Files/

A cozy noir puzzle game where you must investigate the dark underbelly of London. Murders have taken place, witness statements conflict and alibis aren’t adding up. Everyone has a motive, only logic reveals the truth.
